title: util._extend is deprecated
summary: Node.js deprecates util._extend() (DEP0060): documentation-only since v6.0.0, runtime warning since v22.0.0.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace util._extend
steps.instructions: Replace each reported util._extend(target, source) with Object.assign(target, source).
